Kept none as-is: re-cut fig_2 · fig_7 (full-width blank margins), fig_3 (600 dpi native 1-bit raster), fig_4–fig_6 (uniform margins), tab_2 (page → table, 400 dpi); hand-cut fig_1 (300 dpi) and tab_1 (400 dpi). Sixteen numbered equations, all hand-cut at 400 dpi (eq_01…eq_16; Eqs 6, 8, 10 keep their printed 'when α …' condition line). 20 evidence-paragraph crops (≤ 20 rule; 9 of them stack consecutive pieces) · no page_* images. Text layer maps Greek and math to Latin glyphs (e.g. k=π, g=γ, q=ρ, h=θ, j=κ, a=α, b=β, '¼'='=', 'b'/'N'='<'/'>') — every quoted number and symbol was checked on the rendered page. digitized.csv = vector-path reads: Fig. 2 markers, boundaries (both panels, Bezier-sampled) and the M-region edge; Fig. 7 five IS(t) series (95 markers), six bars and the 4c range bar; Figs 4–6 thirteen concentration profiles (mean, bottom-quarter, top-quarter).
